name: NORMIE swapAndLiquify triggered on the token's own balance

classification.summary: NORMIE's _transfer fired an internal swapAndLiquify of the contract's accumulated fee balance whenever that balance crossed a threshold randomised from block.timestamp and block.difficulty, with no slippage bound, so flash-swapped NORMIE routed through the SushiSwap pair let the attacker choose when the contract sold and capture the proceeds.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: NORMIE 0x7F12d13B34F5F4f0a9449c16Bcd42f0da47AF200 created 2024-03-06T22:10:17Z by 0xd8056b0f8aa2126a8db6f0b3109fe9127617beb2, not the attack-tx sender 0xf7f3a556ac21d081f6dba961b6a84e52e37a717d; no EIP-1967 events, 80.2 days old. Its verified source shows _transfer computing tokensToSwap from _minimumTokensBeforeSwap scaled by (keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty) % 11) + 90 and comparing it with balanceOf(address(this)), i.e. a self-balance-triggered swapback. Loss $490K per the DeFiHackLabs 2024 index entry and the PoC header.
